The [[Margrave Octan]] of [[Nallastia]] was a descendant of the [[Royal Octans]] of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]]. Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], he commissioned the [[starship]] ''[[Sun Runner]]'' to transport his family and 867 other [[colonist]]s to the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], there to establish residence on one of [[Fondor]]'s six [[Moon/Legends|moons]], which he had purchased to save it from industrial exploitation. He named the moon after his wife, Nallastia.<ref name="SWA:HTSR">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref><ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>

Like his ruling-family predecessors, the Margrave Octan gained his wealth as a dynastic [[Pirate/Legends|space pirate]] by the use of a precious family heirloom of [[Lost Stars of Nallastia|three power gems]]. These jewels were carried aboard his vessel to disrupt [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic defense shields]], allowing him to overtake targeted ships and seize their property.<ref name="SWA:HTSR" /><ref name=":0" />

The Margrave was bearded and had green eyes.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref> His direct descendant was the [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]], the [[Skull Queen]] of Nallastia.<ref name="SWA:HTSR" />
